title: test(scraper): allow timer slack in the DNS hop timing assertion

summaries.body:
<!-- maple-pr-review 4eaa79b3-c54d-4081-85d3-4679494e0360 0 -->
## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge
A single-line threshold relaxation in one test, and the 35 ms floor still separates two 20 ms hops from one.
<sub>no findings · tests not needed · risk low</sub>

Relaxes the DNS-hop timing floor in `UptimeHttpProbe.test.ts` from 40 ms to 35 ms so two 20 ms timer sleeps that fire a fraction early no longer fail on CI. Test-only and safe to merge.

- `dnsMs` assertion floor drops from 40 ms to 35 ms in the hop-summing test

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- The plain run resolves two distinct hosts (`api.example.com`, then `moved.example.org` on the 302), so each hop's `dnsMs` is summed at `apps/scraper/src/UptimeHttpProbe.ts:60-65`
- 35 ms still exceeds one hop's 20 ms sleep, so dropping per-hop summing or caching lookups fails the assertion

</details>
